member.name: T:LeadPilot.Discovery.Providers.OsmOverpassProvider
member.summary: Free, key-less business discovery from OpenStreetMap: Nominatim resolves the location, Overpass returns named businesses with their published contact tags. Data is © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0); attribution is stored with every lead. Only information that volunteers have mapped is returned, so phone/e-mail/website are often missing – this is reported, never filled in. Respect the public servers' usage policies; for heavy use point Endpoint at your own Overpass instance.

member.name: T:LeadPilot.Discovery.Web.WebsiteExtractor
member.summary: Reads publicly available business information from a company's own website: JSON-LD, meta tags, mailto:/tel: links and visible text. Respects robots.txt (and Crawl-delay), rate-limits per host, refuses private addresses, caps page size and time, and never submits forms, logs in or solves challenges. Anything found is "publicly listed", not "verified".
